notes.title: Back from Nordic Game
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

We’ve finally returned from the incredible Nordic Game game fest, and we’re bursting with excitement to share our experience with you! It was an unforgettable experience filled with learning, networking, and showcasing our latest projects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299901/5f34bd53692a278e80bc079d2f2e2b8616028103.jpg[/img]

[b]Our Showcases[/b]

We were thrilled to present our games SOS OPS!, DLC SOS OPS! - GUNS N'OPS, and Last Hope Bunker: Zombie Survival. But that’s not all – we also teased a secret project that we can’t wait to reveal to you soon!

Our booth attracted a diverse crowd, from solo developers to industry veterans. Developers were curious about the physics and mechanics, while artists appreciated the visual style and design elements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299901/8d45937eb8924b5fa75411e3628001efd2ea804a.jpg[/img]

[b]Engaging with Gamers[/b]

One of the most exciting parts of the festival was seeing players engage with SOS OPS!. We hosted a special mission for the event called IKEA, where players took on the role of a delivery person. It was a hit! Nearly 60 people tried the mission. The enthusiasm was infectious, with many eager to take on the challenge and succeed.


[b]After-Parties and Networking[/b]

The festival wasn’t just about showcasing games; it was also a fantastic opportunity to connect with others in the industry. One of the highlights was an after-party hosted by Sharkmob, a studio based in Malmö. They welcomed everyone into their impressive four-story office for a night of barbecue, drinks, and a sneak peek at their upcoming game. It was a great way to relax and network with fellow developers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299901/3cb625ad51ffd8c0a33d19ca06ca58509fba5c74.jpg[/img]

[b]A Well-Organized Event[/b]

The Nordic Game Festival was impeccably organized. Every detail was taken care of, from the layout of the stands to the amenities provided. Attendees enjoyed complimentary coffee and snacks, ensuring they had the energy to explore and interact all day long. The weather was generally great, though we did have to get used to the constant breeze!

In summary, the Nordic Game Festival was an extraordinary experience for our team. We returned inspired, with new connections and fresh ideas for our games. Stay tuned for more updates, especially about our secret project that we’ll be revealing soon. Thank you for your continued support, and we can’t wait to share more exciting news with you!

See you in the game,
your ArtDock Team

notes.title: SOS OPS! Highlights
notes.content: A recap of the best moments from our players!

notes.title: DevLog # 1
notes.content:
Busting into Friday with exciting news. Here is our DevLog №. 1 🚀

SOS OPS! is evolving every day, and we're eager to share our achievements with players:

1. We've enhanced the underwater camera feed, so when you dive with "open eyes," it'll feel like you are in a remake of "Titanic."
2. Some wondered about the presence of a car if they couldn't get into it. Well, worry not. We've made it effortless for you to get behind the wheel.
3. Not only are "carriages" now more user-friendly, but also trains. Controlling the lever to stop the train is now more convenient.
4. The auto-centering of the camera while driving won't be bothersome with its tilts anymore. We've fixed that too.
5. By the way, you can now organize not only car races but also swimming competitions, as we've added a bit of Michael Phelps magic to the controls.
6. The revamped "Ship Repair" level will capture your hearts and make those who haven't yet acquired SOS OPS! envy you.

⚡️Most importantly, a rooster has joined the game. Wilson rooster. And dear users, it's an exclusive.

We're updating the game at a rapid pace. Exciting content awaits you!
